defects.problem: EXT: The first violins share/double the Trio melody with the first bassoon, and continue alone during a substantial stretch where the bassoon rests. The strings are not merely accompaniment beneath an exposed bassoon solo throughout. The written join changes to piano rather than specifying a gradual diminuendo. INFERENCE: The solo-bassoon-over-strings narrative and bassoon-only lead state misrepresent the texture, and a frame-level drop alone does not establish a composed decrescendo.
defects.evidence: EXT: https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/3/35/IMSLP546546-PMLP34746-JHaydn_Symphony_No.94_fullscore_bh1855.pdf — printed pp. 33–34: corresponding first-violin/bassoon melody, bassoon rests in the second strain, and later doubling. https://geraldlarner.com/work/haydn-symphony-no-94-in-g-major-surprise — Trio characterised through bassoon and violins together.
defects.fix: Describe the first-violin melody with first-bassoon doubling/contribution, noting that the bassoon rests in the middle. Include violins among the Trio leads and correct all dependent solo descriptions, including the da-capo transition. Describe the join as a sudden lighter dynamic/texture and remove decrescendo unless separately evidenced as an actual gradual performance feature.

defects.problem: MEAS: The 3:30 dip is −27.5 dB, not quieter than everything before it: 3:00 and 3:15 are −28.5 dB. Activity then increases again at 3:35–3:40 before the final 3:45 decay. INFERENCE: Calling the 3:25–3:30 change the last loud chords/drop-away ending suppresses the remaining closing phrase and overstates the quietness ranking.
defects.fix: Either describe the 3:25-to-3:30 contrast as an internal loud-to-soft turn followed by renewed activity, or move the ending cue to the actual closing stretch. Do not call 3:30 an unprecedented minimum or the terminal fade.

defects.problem: EXT: The Trio continues onto printed p. 34, where the Menuetto da-capo instruction appears. INFERENCE: The cited movement range ending at p. 33 and the assertion that the da-capo direction is on p. 33 are inaccurate locators.
defects.evidence: EXT: https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/3/35/IMSLP546546-PMLP34746-JHaydn_Symphony_No.94_fullscore_bh1855.pdf — PDF pp. 35–36 = printed pp. 33–34, with Men. D.C. at the end of printed p. 34.
defects.fix: Use printed pp. 30–34 for the movement/Trio range and printed p. 34 for the da-capo instruction.
